verdicts.summary: The modelCatalogOnly branch returns an empty provider list, but the client never writes it into state. A full refresh and a catalog-only refresh use different singleFlight keys, so one cannot absorb the other.
verdicts.scenario: The picker opens, the server answers { providers: [] }, and onSuccess runs. Could the empty list overwrite the workspace snapshots or the config providers? No: onSuccess returns early because instanceId and cwd are undefined (the picker never sends them), so nothing is written. New models still reach the user: a re-probe calls modelCatalog.current again (CodexDriver.ts:238) and the result is published through upsertProviders.

verdicts.summary: The two-pass loop is correct. Once the first awaited pass finishes, any later refreshAll call has to start, or join, a pass that began after the manifest fetch finished.
verdicts.scenario: refreshOnDemand fetches U_new. Pass 0 joins an in-flight pass P that read U_old at line 655, so U_old is recorded. Could pass 1 also join a stale pass? No: refreshAllInFlightRef is cleared at line 670, before the Deferred completes, so pass 1 claims a new pass (or joins one started after P), which reads U_new at line 655 and records it at line 666. A probe failure would need checkProvider to fail with ServerSettingsError (managedProvider.ts:375 turns it into a defect). In that case the ref stays put and later opens try again. That cost is bounded and rare.
